text: True or False: the Christoffel symbols Γ^ρ_μν are the components of a type (1,2) tensor field.
explanation: False. The book stresses that Christoffel symbols are not a tensor: under a coordinate change they acquire an inhomogeneous second-derivative term (∂²xσ/∂x̃ᵘ∂x̃ᵛ) beyond the tensorial part. This is exactly why they can be made to vanish at any single point in normal coordinates yet be nonzero elsewhere, which is impossible for a genuine tensor (a tensor that vanishes in one frame vanishes in all). The tensor built from derivatives of Γ is the Riemann curvature tensor.
